purpose: Strict, offline, read-only runner that wraps the Phase 2G-A shadow validation harness for a real historical price CSV export. It adds two explicit gates (--input-csv required, --confirm-real-data required), CSV pre-flight validation (required columns, benchmark presence, minimum tickers/dates), and a GO_CANDIDATE / NO_GO verdict surfaced from the harness safe_for_canary result. This phase does NOT export from the production database and does NOT run against GCP; it prepares the runner so a later phase can supply a real read-only CSV and execute it.
next_step: Phase 2G-C: produce a real, read-only export of historical price history to a CSV matching this schema (no DB write, no migration, include the benchmark), then run this wrapper with --input-csv <export> --confirm-real-data (and --legacy-csv for the canary gate). Review the resulting rank_ic, top-decile-vs-universe, bucket monotonicity, safe_for_canary, and go_no_go. Enabling PREDICTOR_USE_MODEL_V2 remains a separate, later, human-approved canary phase.
